title: Local derived Hom evaluation is natural in both objects
statement: Let X be a scheme, B a commutative ring, A,D,A′,D′ objects of D(X_et,B), and f:A′→A and g:D→D′ morphisms. For an affine weakly contractible U in X_proet [sk-def-pe-weak-contractible] and s a section of the comparison pullback of the local Hom sheaf from A to D [def-weil-pbc-derived-morphism-sheaf-comparison], evaluation of its image under precomposition with f and postcomposition with g equals restriction to U of comparison(f), followed by evaluation(s), followed by restriction to U of comparison(g).

proof.text: Naturality of the comparison slice isomorphism at f and g gives the corresponding identity for the concrete local Hom maps.
Transpose this local identity under sheafification and comparison adjunctions to obtain naturality of the Hom sheaf comparison.
Use naturality of the pro-etale sheafification unit and injectivity of that unit on the weakly contractible affine U. The inverse-unit equation is the definition of evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedHomEvaluation_natural
    (A' D' : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (f : A' ⟶ A) (g : D ⟶ D') (U : X.ProEt) [IsAffine U.left]
    (hU : (ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} U)
    (s : ((comparisonSetUpperStar X).obj
      (derivedLocalHomSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B A D)).obj.obj (op U)) :
    derivedHomEvaluation X B A' D' U hU
        (((comparisonSetUpperStar X).map
          ((presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))).map
            (derivedLocalHomPresheafMap f g))).hom.app (op U) s) =
      (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) B U).map
          ((derivedComparison X B).map f) ≫
        derivedHomEvaluation X B A D U hU s ≫
          (derivedSliceRestriction (ProEt.topology X) B U).map
            ((derivedComparison X B).map g)
